gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.810389 35.918011)',4326)::geography, 700)
    AND p.leisure = 'golf_course'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 480;

WITH home_street_park AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-77.810389, 35.918011), 4326)::geography, 700) AS geom
),
golf_courses AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.poi_name,
    p.addr_city,
    p.addr_state,
    p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.leisure = 'golf course'
    AND p.addr_state = 'NC'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM home_street_park), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM home_street_park))
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT
    gc.id,
    gc.poi_name,
    gc.addr_city,
    gc.addr_state,
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(gc.geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM golf_courses gc
  CROSS JOIN clipped_dem r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(gc.geometry, 4326), r.rast)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS golf_courses_below_480m
FROM elevation_values
WHERE elevation <= 480;
